lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical line segments observed; spacing is approximately equidistant with a minor compression of gaps in the mid-torso section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior line 1 is truncated, terminating before reaching the dorsal line; posterior lines 9, 10, and 11 terminate mid-flank above the hind limb transition.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior haunch/upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior flank align horizontally to form a semi-linear geometric pattern below the terminus of the vertical lines.

other_distinctive_markers: A white chevron-shaped marking is visible on the bridge of the snout; distinct white patches are present on the throat and lower neck; white bands are visible on the inner medial surfaces of the limbs.
